title: Sydney Sweeney Proves She Doesn't Give Two F**ks About The Haters - Stars In Another 'American Eagle' Ad [VIDEO + PHOTOS] - NewsBreak
text:
By Darrelle Lincoln ,
56 minutes ago
Sydney Sweeney (Photo via Getty Images) Days after the ‘Euphoria’ star dressed as a dog in the Season 3 premiere, Sydney Sweeney was back making headlines. She tapped into the biggest controversy she had in 2025.
Sweeney’s 2025–2026 American Eagle campaign, “Sydney Sweeney Has Great Jeans,” caused significant online debate, with the slogan playing on “genes” vs. “jeans.” The campaign aimed to celebrate American Eagle’s denim, featuring Sweeney wearing and designing specific styles.
Unfortunately, it turned into much more than that online. She took a major hit from many who have accused American Eagle of playing to a white supremacist notion that the human race could be improved by breeding out less desirable traits.
“Genes are passed down from parents to offspring, often determining traits like hair color, personality, and even eye color. My genes are blue,” Sweeney says in one video.
Sweeney’s brother, Trent, certainly had her back as he wrote, “It’s them good jeans 🥸” following the backlash.
Now, Sydney Sweeney and American Eagle are back.
Sydney Sweeney Debuts New American Eagle ad Actress Sydney Sweeney is stepping back into the spotlight with American Eagle despite what happened last year. This time, she traded denim jeans for a summer-ready campaign centered around shorts.
The Euphoria actress reunited with the clothing retailer for a new promotion titled “Syd for Short.” It’s a seasonal campaign highlighting American Eagle’s latest line of shorts. In the first promotional clip, Sweeney is wearing a fitted pair of denim shorts paired with a classic jean jacket.
With her hands in her pockets, she playfully asks viewers, “What brand am I wearing?” before replying with, “Yeah. That one.” It’s unclear whether the ad is a wink to the controversy of her previous campaign.
In an interview with GQ in November 2025, Sweeney spoke to the backlash. She said, “I mean, the reaction definitely was a surprise, but I love jeans. All I wear are jeans. I’m in jeans and a T-shirt every day of my life.”
